profile.name: Nagaraju Reddy Boggala
profile.title: Backend & Platform Engineer
profile.summary: Backend & Platform Engineer with 3 years of experience building highly available and secure distributed systems. Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) with hands-on expertise in Redis HA (Sentinel), RabbitMQ HA, Kubernetes, TLS/mTLS security, performance optimization, and production observability using Prometheus-Grafana. Specialized in backend infrastructure, automation, and reliability engineering for enterprise-grade systems.

description: Designed Redis Sentinel HA clusters and Valkey caching layer, implementing TLS encryption for secure inter-service communication and achieving zero-downtime failover capabilities.
Optimized RabbitMQ processing pipeline by implementing batch consumer architecture, improving message throughput by 200% and significantly reducing database load in high-volume environments.
Implemented mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication using X.509 certificates across services, eliminating plaintext credential exposure and achieving enterprise-grade security compliance.
Built centralized monitoring and alerting infrastructure using Prometheus and Grafana covering Redis HA, RabbitMQ HA, Memcached and VM metrics for production observability.
Performed production debugging and performance analysis using Redis Insight to diagnose replication lag, memory fragmentation, and optimize resource utilization.
Implemented persistent Kubernetes storage using Longhorn on bare-metal clusters, ensuring stateful workload durability and fault tolerance across container and node failures.
Developed Jenkins pipeline automation and Bash scripts to execute performance tests (Memtier) and generate comprehensive release validation reports.
Upgraded backend dependencies (Flask, Pydantic, OpenAPI) across microservices, improving service stability, maintainability, and compatibility with modern frameworks.
